visibleEditorialCopy.description: In Luc Besson's romantic fantasy-comedy, an inept scam artist finds an unexpected lifeline when an alluring, enigmatic woman steps into his life to help him pull his scattered world together.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A medium-paced, humorous fantasy romance with moderate emotional weight that makes for an easy, engaging evening watch.
